== 20% ==
These two leaves in Kate’s garden always attract ladybirds. The left leaf always has ladybirds with four spots on and the right leaf always has ladybirds with six spots on. How many spots would there be in total if one more ladybird lands on each leaf?

[[File:Ladybirds leaf.png|frameless]]

Left leaf: five ladybirds = 20 spots. Right leaf: four ladybirds = 24. TOTAL = '''44'''
